== Grand Slam 2000 series (October 2026) ==
=== Build notes ===
* Sibling pages for the other Grand Slam 2000 SWCCG events were built from Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 results page (Wayback 16 July 2001) and the Grand Slam calendar (Wayback 11 March 2001), which groups completed events by month.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The calendar lists Seattle (SWCCG winner "Doug Harvilla") under January 2000; this page says February 2000 (from the Deck Designs label). Not changed.
* Portland winner "Joe Olson" left unlinked: not clearly the modern [[Joe Olson]] (arebelspy).
* Denver winner is printed "Clint Hayes"; linked to [[Clint Hays]].
=== Missing data ===
* Boston's SWCCG winner is "?" in the source; 13 later weekends have no SWCCG winner listed. Exact dates are not given (month only; Portland has no month). [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 21:55, 13 October 2026 (UTC)

== Remaining Grand Slam 2000 weekends (October 2026) ==
=== Missing data ===
* Pages created for Boston and the 12 later weekends (Linköping, Houston, Landshut, Virginia Beach, Brussels, Nashville, Los Angeles, Blue Springs, Krakow, Birmingham, Minneapolis, Phoenix) with winner "Unknown": Decipher's results page records no SWCCG winner (Boston shows "?"). Dates/sites for the later weekends come from the upcoming-events calendar; no source confirms they were held as scheduled.
* Mildura (May 2000) not created: both Decipher pages list only a Star Trek CCG event there, no SWCCG event.
=== Corrections ===
* Portland winner Joe Olson is the existing [[Joe Olson]] (confirmed by Bill); now linked. Portland date (10 June 2000), site and TD (Glenn Hall) added from the calendar. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 22:15, 13 October 2026 (UTC)
